scenes.hook: You search for a rainy trip, but the note says wet weekend. Exact word matching might miss the connection.
scenes.idea: Semantic search uses embeddings: numerical representations that capture useful relationships between pieces of content.
scenes.demo: A query and a document can be compared in that numerical space, even when their wording differs.
scenes.compare: This helps retrieve related material. Some systems can compare images, audio, or video as well as text.
scenes.takeaway: Similarity is not a guarantee of truth. Inspect the results and test how the search behaves.
scenes.close: When would meaning based search help? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
